title: Sam Altman told staff he has ceded oversight of OpenAI's safety and security teams to focus on fundraising, supply chains, and building data centers at scale (The Information)
summary: The Information: Sam Altman told staff he has ceded oversight of OpenAI's safety and security teams to focus on fundraising, supply chains, and building data centers at scale — OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has relinquished direct oversight of the company's safety and security teams so he can focus on raising capital …
